examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Default switch. Use the Controls panel to flip modelValue, kind, and focused.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Switch from '@aziontech/webkit/switch'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const modelValue = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <Switch
    v-model="modelValue"
    aria-label="Toggle setting"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: Both kind variants in off and on states. Privacy adds a lock (off) / lock-open (on) icon inside the handle.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Disabled in both positions. The lock reads the same either way — the disabled track and handle tokens win over the checked ones — and neither click nor Space/Enter emits.
